note: Principles the canon researches. Om edits this list; canon:refresh turns each into a draft in canon/drafts/.

seeds.name: One primary action per view
seeds.intent: Each view has one visually dominant action; the rest are quieter.

seeds.name: Outcome first
seeds.intent: Lead with the result or status, then the detail that supports it.

seeds.name: The number is the hero
seeds.intent: On money and metric screens, the key figure is the largest element.

seeds.name: Specific time over vague time
seeds.intent: Say exactly when something happens rather than soon or in a few days.

seeds.name: Calm confirmation
seeds.intent: Confirm serious actions calmly and factually, without celebration.

seeds.name: Progressive disclosure
seeds.intent: Show what most people need first; reveal the rest on demand.

seeds.name: Labels stay visible
seeds.intent: Field labels sit outside the field and never disappear when typing.

seeds.name: Errors say what and how
seeds.intent: Errors explain what went wrong and how to fix it, without blame.

seeds.name: Undo over confirm
seeds.intent: Prefer undo for reversible actions; confirm only what cannot be undone.

seeds.name: Destructive actions last
seeds.intent: Destructive actions sit apart and last, and ask for confirmation.

seeds.name: Readable measure
seeds.intent: Keep text and form columns to a comfortable reading width.

seeds.name: One spacing scale
seeds.intent: All spacing comes from one scale, so rhythm stays consistent.

seeds.name: Density follows the task
seeds.intent: Dense layouts for scanning data; generous space for decisions.

seeds.name: Copyable identifiers
seeds.intent: References and IDs people must quote can be copied in one action.

seeds.name: Factual trust cues
seeds.intent: Build trust with concrete facts and controls, not decorative badges.

seeds.name: Empty states teach
seeds.intent: An empty state explains what will appear and offers the next step.

seeds.name: Keyboard path matches the visual path
seeds.intent: Focus order follows the visual reading order.

seeds.name: Hierarchy without colour alone
seeds.intent: Convey importance with size, weight and position, not colour alone.

seeds.name: Consistent alignment edges
seeds.intent: Elements share a few alignment edges, so the page reads as one grid.

seeds.name: Defaults that protect
seeds.intent: Risky or costly options are off by default and need a deliberate choice.
